chunks: De al-Mughīra ibn Saʿīd, Abū Jaʿfar (la paz sea con él) salió y dijo:
En verdad, él solía mentirnos, y solía llamar a Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥasan, al principio de su asunto.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَر: Abū Jaʿfar, refiriéndose a Imam al-Bāqir
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdullāh, conocido como Muḥammad al-Nafs al-Zakiyya

ai.seo_question: Who did Abū Jaʿfar (peace be upon him) say was lying against them and calling for Muḍammad ibn ʿAbdullāh?
ai.summary: Al-Mughīra ibn Saʿīd narrates that Abū Jaʿfar (Imam al-Bāqir) stated that a person used to lie against the Ahl al-Bayt and called for Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥasan during the early stage of his movement or cause.
